# `null` and nullable types (`T?`)

Prefix `LNUL`. A first-class absent value, in place of `""` as
missing: negated existence is
[LNUL.4.7] and the narrowing boundary is [LNUL.5.4]. Paired
with [LEXP] (operators / `??`),
[LDET],
[LGRA] (`T?` surface), and [LSER] (the series
boundary, [LNUL.7]). The DSC `null` encoding is [LNUL.6.3].
